answer: An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 4 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Since the oasis hash is stored at intake, the juniper graph groups the endorsements and the lagoon audit publishes the collapse. An operator copying one text across 172 aliases thus forfeits for 172 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
